method.amplitude: hypot(Re,Im), original signed int8 Im/Re; 52 data+pilot LLTF tones, DC/guards excluded
method.row_mean: Equal weight of all 52 valid active tones; incomplete required row makes full-window aggregate unavailable
method.variability: Population temporal standard deviation per tone; separately population std of per-row spatial means
method.weights: Equal observed rows, not duration-weighted; no interpolation, resampling, demeaning or normalization
method.clocks: Original host monotonic read return and first-byte/read boundaries, not RF time; local uint32 retained in references
method.configuration: Conditional ESP-IDF v5.4 ESP32-S3 HT20 non-STBC model; merge/filter/auto-scale retained; installed binary not attested
method.uncertainty: Human yes labels, unknown timing uncertainty; mean ± sigma is dispersion, not confidence interval

limitations: one connection, fixed E then S order, one person/mounting/day

uncalibrated int8 amplitudes, gain/AGC and radio environment not independently controlled
